title: Tuesday Quick Tip
subtitle: The huddle when it is lopsided
hook: You are down by a lot. What do you say in the huddle?
intro: Your players are looking at the ground.
statement: Kids take their cue from how you carry the moment.
q1: Do you set a small goal for the next few minutes —
q2: or let the score go and talk about having fun?
q3: What do you want them to remember from this game?
t1: There is no single right way. But kids keep trying
t2: when there is still something to play for.
cta: Coaches — what do you say when it is lopsided?
ctaLines: Win the next five minutes. Three good passes.
A new goal or just enjoy the game?
ctaPrompt: Share your huddle habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
You are down by a lot. What do you say in the huddle?
Your players are looking at the ground.
Kids take their cue from how you carry the moment.
Set a small goal or let the score go. There is no perfect answer.
What do you say when it is lopsided? Share your habit in the comments.
